column1: # The text of reflectHowToSubmit as 0.44.2 shipped it, before the reply carried an outline: the fixed value that
# TestTheOutlineOfHowToSubmitLosesNoPhraseOfTheOldText holds the outline in the reply and the section of review.md to.
# text    the whole old text, one line (the phrases below cover it in order: what lies between two phrases is only
#         the separators ; , . : ( ) and spaces, so no word of it is left out of the table)
# phrase  id, the phrase as the old text has it, the words of it that the new section of review.md must have on one line,
#         and the words of it that the outline in the reply must keep (empty: the phrase may live in the section only)
#         words are separated by " | "; case, backticks and runs of spaces do not count; a word must be in its phrase
# Format of a phrase row, separated by tabs:  phrase  id  phrase  section words  outline words

column2: submit reviews:[{source_id,trace_id,truth,reason}] with your own truth yes/no/unknown; wiki:[{sources,title,lesson,body,applies_to,related,kind,scene}] (applies_to names the command or file the lesson is about, such as make test or version.go, so it reaches the agent right before that command or file; only sources when there is no lesson; for a new lesson run operation:place first and choose id and replaces from its candidates and suspected contradictions; an id replaces the whole body: to add, change or shorten, use shikii wiki patch first (it needs the article's id and current revision, read with wiki query lesson:<id> first, and edits:[{field:"body",before,after}]; to add, before is a unique ending of the body and after is that ending plus your new text), and only when that does not fit send the existing body again with your additions copied exactly; a body that drops half or more of the old one, or of the revision the saves began from, is refused; keep the short lesson and the detailed body apart); memory:[{source_id,key,result,decision,evidence,correction_result}] (one item per entry of every source's memories[], source_id as this reply's memories[].source_id: a lesson delivered before a tool call has its own, and one delivered to a subagent is not listed: that subagent assesses it; the pending conversations are listed oldest first, the oldest two with their raw text and the next as head: true with the text cut, read with wiki query <id> when a lesson needs it; more_pending counts the ones that did not fit, and the next query lists them) with result helpful/unused/harmful/unknown and, for a delivered correction, correction_result followed/repeated/not_applicable/unknown (another lesson takes only followed, with unknown when the work went the lesson's way but its effect is not shown), tied to a check result (delivery, success, a greeting or silence is no effect; else unknown; observations are sources holding check results); maintenance: for at most 2 pages, review the body, related pages, sources and any feedback (saved delivery decisions and evidence), then send the latest page_id, revision, key and reason. Unused does not mean incorrect: repair applicability or content only when supported; no-change reviews count. Never change a revision just to restore delivery. Read the sources and existing pages before merging. Update changed knowledge in the matching article. When there is no new knowledge, submit sources only. Keep decisions, observations and proposals distinct, with conditions and exceptions. Before saving new or revised wiki claims, follow the skill's references/source-review.md. A rule, test or procedure (command or script) you made or changed goes to the wiki even without a correction (a howto or rule page, or the closest page). For an explicit correction attach correction:{source_id,quote,action} (the person's raw words, the next action); if it can be a fixed check (paired files / words not to use / words a commit body must contain), add a disabled draft with `shikii guard add` and ask the person to enable it. Quotes are never permission, truths or calibration. On an error, fix it and resend; complete:true only means every item sent was saved: while left lists a conversation, submit what it names. Manual searches: discoveries:[{lookup_id,page_id,revision,context,decision,evidence,case_id?}] records only evidenced use of a query result, never just reading; optional case_id links a complete diagnostic for that work and exact revision, reopening missed-delivery maintenance. Wiki rationale keeps source-backed choices, rejected alternatives and reasons; watch lists at most four relative project files whose changes require rechecking. Details: read `## Place a new lesson before saving it` in the skill's references/wiki.md, not the whole file.
